parameters.slotId: The host image slot supplying this picture.
parameters.aspect: The width divided by the height of the picture.
parameters.semanticLabel: Describes the picture to a screen reader.
parameters.fit: How the image or drawing fits its allocated bounds.
parameters.width: Sets the width of the media frame.
parameters.bare: Draws the image without its usual frame.
parameters.image: Caller-supplied content instead of a media slot, such as an asset image.
